evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with nominal compositions of Ti-45Al-8Nb and Ti-45Al-8Nb-1.3Si (at%) were prepared by cold crucible induction levitation melting. The raw materials used were a Ti sponge (99.9% purity), high-purity Al (99.99% purity), and intermediate alloys Al-75wt%Nb, and Al-20wt%Si. To ensure the homogeneity of the alloy composition, the ingots were remelted twice
The molten alloys were then poured into a permanent steel mold of /Phi140 mm. Subsequently, the actual compositions of the alloys were analyzed; these are summarized in Table 1 .
